messages.finale: Every Love Story Is Beautiful, But Ours Is My Favorite.
messages.love_letter:
My dearest love,

Every moment with you feels like a beautiful dream I never want to wake from. Thank you for your laughter, your kindness, your endless love.

Forever yours.
messages.surprise: I booked our dream dinner under the stars this weekend! Pack your smile, I'll handle the rest.
